verdict.rationale: The docs/skills.md file enumerates gstack's built-in skills (review, QA, ship, autoplan, learn, etc.) with short descriptions, letting a developer read through what's available before installing, functioning as a rudimentary static catalog. However there's no evidence of a searchable registry, leaderboard, ranking, or marketplace UI, nor any third-party/community skill listings beyond the fixed bundled set. Missing for 10: a searchable/browsable interface (web or CLI) distinct from raw markdown, evidence of a marketplace or leaderboard ranking skills, and support for discovering community-contributed skills beyond gstack's own bundle.
